what: Which grid operator a state commission's row is placed under on /cost-of-power (the block Rules in motion), when the row is about one named utility. warehouse/derived/rules_in_motion.py reads this file. A row is about one utility when the caption of its docket (the proceeding's title, or the docket number where the commission prints the utility there) holds one of the names below. Such a row goes under that utility's operator and no other; where 'operator' is null the row is placed under no grid and counted in not_on_page with the reason. A caption that names a company, cooperative or corporation this file does not list is placed only where the docket's own documents name an operator, else under no grid. A row whose caption names no company is a statewide rule and goes under the state's operators (STATE_GRIDS in the builder).

sources.how: FERC's orders of 18 June 2026 instituting proceedings on each operator's tariff name, in their captions, the operator and its transmission owners. A utility whose 'source' is one of these dockets stands by name in that order's caption (checked by a test against the saved order where the raw store is held). A utility whose 'source' is 'stated plainly' is not in a caption read: its operator is written here as common knowledge of the US power system, with the reason.
